People in Valencia celebrate the coming of spring with the Fallas festival. This festival takes place from March 15 to 19. (A) [During / While] the festival, people enjoy parades and fireworks. The stars of the festival are fallas, giant wooden statues. You can find hundreds of them all over the city. Surprisingly, the fallas are burned (B) [at / on] the last day of the festival. Burning (C) [it / them] symbolizes saying goodbye to old things and hello to a new start.

questions.promptEn:
다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

The Goesan Gimjang festival takes place in Goesan on the first weekend of November. During the festival, many people come together to make gimchi. There are also other events such as K-pop concerts. Come to Goesan and enjoy the festival. ⓐ함께 김치를 담그는 것은 재미있을 겁니다.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말을 다음 조건에 맞게 바르게 영작하시오.

[조건]
1. will, fun, it, make, together를 이용할 것.
2. 총 8단어로 쓸 것.
3. 대소문자와 구두점에 유의할 것.
accept: It will be fun to make gimchi together
